summary: Iteration 6 retested all features in the review request. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass. New file test_iter6_rooms_ws.py covers the 403 'Not your turn' rule for turn seat vs host, 422 when the seat set changes, 409 on version conflict, a bad token, the WS initial room message, the WS broadcast on push, ping/pong, and WS close 4403 for an invalid token. Frontend works for: 1920x800 layout (no page scroll; history and props scroll inside their panels); 3D dice (data-face matches the history roll and the final transform is axis-aligned, 76x76 square); sector info following the highlighted cell (option cell, re-click current cell, inspect outside move); the Kapmonia buy flow, where module and self-rent are still available after buying and end turn works; the rent selector; shared property; conversion vote; the props panel; exchange; sound toggle; mobile tabs; and the two-context online flow (WS sync about 0.3 s, guest turn syncs to host, close and reopen shows start-rejoin-btn and rejoin works). Rent selector details: only built options appear, double rent only when the whole group is shared, pay buttons are disabled until an option is chosen, the sum updates, paying deducts and logs, nar_nar shows only the nar button, and Kapmonia shows a single preselected rentMax plus act-tender-btn. Shared property details: indBuy gives 'Долевая народная собственность' 100%, a sole owner builds with no vote, 50/50 builds go through a vote with the premium paid to the initiator, and hot-seat humans can vote No for 40/60 (rejected). Conversion vote: refunds are correct (cell+modules value × share in g) and owners become all players equally. Props panel: row selection, mortgage/redeem, sell dialog, tender and collect toggles all work, and buttons are disabled on a nar property and when it is not the player's turn. Exchange appears only in kap_nar and its preview updates live (300$ → 3 g). Failed: the offline banner never appears when the network drops (see RCA). Minor issues: modal fade swallows clicks, inverted menu sound label, cramped history at 1366x700, and a few cosmetic items.

ui_bugs.issue: With context offline (navigator.onLine=false) for 10 s, net-banner stayed hidden and net-rejoin-btn never appeared. The established WebSocket is not closed, so wsOpen stays true. setLost() (net.js:102) sets banner.hidden = !session || wsOpen, which hides the banner even after the 'offline' event (net.js:152) and failed polls (net.js:95). There is also no pong timeout: ping is sent every 4 s (net.js:135) but a missing pong is never detected. On real networks the same thing happens until the TCP connection times out, which can take minutes.

base.css:126 hides .modal with opacity plus a visibility transition, so the backdrop keeps catching clicks for the transition time after closing. Clicks right after a dialog closes are swallowed. Seen twice: sound-toggle-btn right after the sell dialog closed, and roll-dice-btn right after a menu choice. Fix: .modal:not(.is-open){pointer-events:none}.
The label is inverted or confusing (game.js:730). With sound ON it reads 'Звук выключен ✕'; with sound OFF it reads 'Звук включён'. Use action labels like 'Выключить звук' / 'Включить звук'.
The third tab (Объекты: sector + props) has data-testid 'tab-history', but history actually lives in the Игроки tab. Rename it to tab-props.

issues: #history-list is only 34 px tall (one line visible) because the turn-order cards take the column height. Use compact player cards, or give history a min-height of about 140 px and let players-list scroll.
The page scrolls (docH 1045) and the fixed bottom tab bar covers the last history lines. Acceptable, but consider fitting the panel to the viewport like on desktop.
Board corner labels wrap mid-word ('NARMONYON CENTRAR Y', 'BLA CK HO LE').
Wrong grammar: 'Аренда 1 модулей' (economy.js:16). Needs plural forms: 1 модуля / 2-4 модулей.
The dashed route SVG is not redrawn on viewport resize, so after a resize it cuts across the board centre. Cosmetic.

action_items: net.js: show net-banner when navigator.onLine is false or a poll fails, even if wsOpen is true. Add a pong timeout (e.g. no pong within 8 s → ws.close() → reconnect). Also call ws.close() on the 'offline' event so the state is consistent.
base.css: add .modal:not(.is-open){pointer-events:none} so clicks right after a dialog closes are not lost.
game.js:730: fix the inverted sound menu label.
Rename mobile tab testid tab-history → tab-props (the label is Объекты).
Layout at short desktop heights (≤700 px) with 4 players: keep the history list usable.

economy.js sharedBuild: round the premium share to whole $ (wallets end up at 1847.99 / 1810.01). sharedPlan only checks that each co-owner can pay their share, not the premium; if a co-owner can't pay the premium it is silently skipped (economy.js:395-396).
critical_code_review_comments: game.js is 1015 lines (>700). Split it into modules, e.g. dialogs/rent selector, votes/auction/joint, dice/board render, bot turn.
net.js:135: the interval always calls poll() even when the WS is open (comma operator), so there is a 4 s REST poll per client on top of the WS. It works, but the load is redundant. Intended?

sellToBank in kap_nar turns the Kapmonia cell into people's property owned equally by all players (economy.js:440-442), so the seller still sees it in their props list at 50%. Confirm this is the intended rule.
vote(): if the initiator is not a co-owner they get no vote weight, which is correct by spec. A bot that can't afford its share votes No for sharedBuild (botYes), which is fine.
Backend push_state correctly uses the stored state's active seat. The host can still push at any time (needed to drive bots); acceptable by spec.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_admin_rooms.py (guest push without turn now expects 403; host pushes instead)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Local game helper: start-new-game-btn → scenario-card-<id> → total-minus-btn x2 (2 players) [real-plus-btn for hot-seat 2 humans] → player-name-input-0 → go-to-draw-btn → click draw-action-btn until body[data-screen=game]. Bots open prompts for the human (vote/joint/auction); auto-handle them by clicking the last enabled '#modal.is-open .dlg-btns button'. State setup: m=MP.ui.match; m.cells[id]={type:'shared'|'private',owners:{pid:share},modules,dome,built:false,mortgaged:false,tender,collect:true,fund:{}}; m.current.recordMove(id, ring); m.phase='await_end'; m.turnState.stage='post'; m.turnState.due={id} (or null); m.changed(); then click cell-actions-btn. In kap_nar ring 1 = kap and ring 2 = nar. Online: guest via page.context.browser.new_context(), goto the lobby-invite-link value (?room=CODE), fill lobby-name-input, click lobby-join-btn, host clicks lobby-start-btn. Playwright set_offline does NOT close open WebSockets, so it reproduces the stale-wsOpen banner bug.
rca of the issue: Offline banner: net.js setLost(true) runs a 2.5 s timer that sets banner.hidden = !session || wsOpen. wsOpen only becomes false in ws.onclose. When the network drops without a TCP FIN (Wi-Fi loss, or Playwright offline emulation), onclose doesn't fire for a long time. The 'offline' event and failed polls call setLost(true), but the banner stays hidden. Repro: 2-context online match → ctx2.set_offline(True) → wait 10 s → net-banner.hidden === true. Mitigation: track lastPong, and treat !navigator.onLine or poll failure as lost regardless of wsOpen (force-close the ws).
